retry_policy: maximum one retry for timeout, transport failure or provider 5xx/429 honoring Retry-After; same query/provider only; no retry for empty success, parser failure, invalid result or contamination
failure_policy: record the failed attempt and mark that query/provider cell unavailable after the bounded retry; never substitute another provider for that cell
replacement_policy: only the next unused query from the already frozen same-arm, same-provider stratum may replace a failed query; no topic, arm or provider substitution; replacements consume budget
contamination_policy: canonicalize scheme/host/path/query, remove fragments, reject any URL in V1/V2/V3/V4/historical sets or current accepted set; reject duplicate URL across providers within the experiment
balance_policy: maintain 1:1 Treatment/Control by matched pair and equal provider exposure; if a replacement would break a cell, do not apply it
provider_failure_policy: pause immediately on provider unavailable, missing credential, rate limit beyond retry, or canary failure; do not reroute; resume only after operator revalidation under the same frozen contract, otherwise declare capture infeasible
stopping_rule: stop successfully only when both arms have >=474 valid rows and all provider strata/integrity gates pass; stop inconclusive on exhaustion of the frozen universe, budget, or provider availability without target; never stop on relevance, p-value, lift or interim arm behavior
